description: Walk-forward tennis Elo on a stable player identity (sports/wta/elo.py). FiveThirtyEight-style decaying K, k = k_numerator / (prior_matches + k_offset) ** k_shape, kept separately for an overall and a per-surface rating; the match probability uses overall_weight * overall + (1 - overall_weight) * surface. Every prediction uses only matches dated before it. Tournament-winner probabilities come from a seeded knockout Monte Carlo over the field (sports/wta/tournament_sim.py).
selection: k_numerator, k_offset, k_shape, overall_weight and update_on_walkovers picked by log-loss on 2021-2022 matches only (grid 150-250 x 5,10 x 0.4,0.5 x 0.5,0.6,0.7 x walkovers on/off); 2023-2025 was not used to choose them. initial_rating cancels out (every player starts equal).

evaluation.definition: tour-level singles dated 2023-01-01..2025-12-31, Davis Cup / BJK Cup (level D) and walkovers excluded, as in the 2026-10 markets plan
